text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: You know, there's an all-you-can-eat bread place, and it was sooooo delicious!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Going every day made my weight marvelous☆
But if I run and lose it, that'll be even more marvelooous★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Still, if you run outta juice every single time, you'll never get anywhere."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If it's for a diet, wouldn't low-impact exercise
be better? Let's see, for example—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All right, take a deep breath in~~. And out~~.
In again~~. And out~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "According to this book, that was a yoga pose for dieting, but what do you think?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—...Yeah! The oxygen rushing through me
and heating up my body feels simply Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Good, good, you like it? Looks like there are other effective
poses too, so wanna try them all out?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "I'll do it, I'll do it! Nature, you looked up so much stuff for me!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Thanks for helping me with my diet!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It'd be a problem if my roommate passed out every time.
Well, this much is nothing.
Afterward, with Nice Nature's help, Marvelous Sunday successfully got her weight back to normal.
